fill: signal at closed bar i -> market at bar i+1 open; 20bps/side
indicators: atr14 = SMA14 of TR
bb_mid=SMA(n) close; bb_up=mid+k*std(n,ddof=0); bw=(up-lo)/mid
squeeze: bw[i-1] <= rolling(120).quantile(q) of bw shifted 1; true if any in last 5 bars
state 0->1 on close>bb_up and squeeze; 1->0 on close<bb_mid; entry only on 0->1 edge
stops: initial = fill_px - stop_m*ATR(signal bar), active from fill bar, fills at min(open,stop); trail: stop=max(stop, close - trail_m*ATR)
exits: stop (intrabar) > state==0 (exit next open) > bars since fill >= max_hold (exit next open)
funding: applied at settlement bar open on held qty
